grade.rationale: The candidate correctly states OAuth 2.1 as the current mode per elm-auth-2026, fully captures the change (API keys replaced by OAuth 2.1 beginning 2026, key acceptance ended), and preserves the 2025 API-key requirement as historical without rewriting it as false, satisfying the prohibited-merge constraint. Lineage is established via shared subject_id/lineage_id rather than name similarity, so no false merge; no superseded evidence is presented as current; no historical claim is lost. All factual claims trace to the two primary snapshots, so unsupported_claims is 0. The sole weakness is the unresolved section: the reference ledger lists nothing unresolved, but the candidate invents three open questions — a precision demand on the effective date, doubt about post-2026 currency that the ledger treats as settled, and peripheral migration/grace-period details — which cannot be rewarded and add audit noise, lowering unresolved_accuracy and usefulness slightly.
